# MM-P3-L1-HP01 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01

## Scope
This document defines the maintenance procedure for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press EQ-P3-L1-HP01. It covers routine mechanical and hydraulic checks required to verify safe operation and to return the press to service following planned maintenance. Refer to MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 for the inspection checklist and to SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-02 for operator and lockout/tagout procedures.

## Tools
- Fixed and adjustable wrenches sized to match fasteners on EQ-P3-L1-HP01
- Torque wrench capable of applying the main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m
- Pressure gauge calibrated for system verification up to the system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 330 bar
- Hydraulic fluid handling kit and drip containment
- Clean lint-free rags and visual inspection mirror

## Procedure
- Isolate EQ-P3-L1-HP01 per SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-02 before any maintenance.
- Drain and contain hydraulic fluid following plant environmental practices; inspect reservoir and filters using MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.
- Visually inspect ram assembly, hose runs, fittings, and structural fasteners for wear or damage.
- Re-torque main ram bolts to the main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m using the calibrated torque wrench. Torque sequence: follow manufacturer flange pattern documented in MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.
- Refill and purge hydraulic system, then verify system pressure does not exceed the system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 330 bar using the calibrated pressure gauge.
- Return EQ-P3-L1-HP01 to service only after successful checks and completion of post-maintenance inspection per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.

## Acceptance criteria
- No visual defects or leaks remain on EQ-P3-L1-HP01.
- Main ram bolts torqued to the main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m and verified in maintenance record.
- Operational system pressure verified at or below the system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 330 bar.
- All steps documented and signed as required by SOP-P3-L1-01 and SOP-P3-L1-02.
